trace.query: What are the requirements for the full varsity scholarship?

SECTION: Chapter 3 | Article 10. Scholarships. Scholarship grants and all other forms of financial assistance shall be awarded in accordance with pertinent rules and regulations.
Article 10. Scholarships. Scholarship grants and all other forms of financial assistance shall be awarded in accordance with pertinent rules and regulations.

Sec. 1. Academic Scholars

1.1. Government and Private Company Scholarship. Scholarship and study grants by government and private companies or individuals are also available for needy and deserving students.

1.4. Only one (1) government/public office scholarship is allowed for every qualified scholar.

Sec. 2. Non-academic Scholars

2.1. Varsity Scholars. The university provides incentives to deserving and dedicated athletes. This scholarship is divided into:

2.1.1. Full Scholarship/Training Allowance: SCUAA medalists whether gold, silver or bronze; grade average of 2.0 for the semester immediately proceeding; and possess good moral character

2.1.2. Half Scholarship/Training Allowance: point contributors in SCUAA; SCUAA finalists; average grade of 2.5 and maximum grade of 2.0.

2.2. Advanced ROTC

2.3. Cultural and the Performing Arts

2.4. Band Member

2.5. Student Government (President)

2.6. Publication (Editor-in-Chief)

B. ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS

The requirements listed below should be in PDF format for uploading in the LSPU Online Application System. The clear and readable documents to be uploaded will be verified and serve as the basis of qualifications.

NOTE: No original copies of documents will be asked during the admission process. Please keep them for the enrolment process.

1. College Qualification
   General Weighted Average (GWA)
   As stipulated in the LSPU Handbook 2021, the colleges may set their respective qualifications on the general weighted average (GWA) of students to be admitted to the program (board or non-board) in consideration of accommodation capacity and standards. For the list of programs and their respective GWA requirements, please see "Annex A" on page 4.

2. Documentary Requirements

   For First Year College (Freshmen) Applicants:
   a. Recent 2x2 ID Picture (white background)
   b. Birth Certificate (PSA/NSO)
   c. Certificate of Good Moral Character (with certification of current grade level and school year)
   d.

SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 1. Academic Awards
Article 1. Academic Awards

Sec. 1. Description. This pertains to awards given to students who showed academic proficiency and excellence in their respective courses.

Sec. 2. Policies and Guidelines

2.1. Students carrying normal academic load each semester (unless otherwise carrying of lighter load is justifiable like that of a working student but not less than 15 units each semester) who completed their courses with the following averages, computed on the basis of units, shall have graduated with honors, provided they meet all the requirements.

2.3. Provided further that they must have completed in this university at least 75% of the total number of units or hours required for graduation and must have been in residence in this university at least two (2) years immediately prior to graduation.

2.4. Students who completed a curriculum in the degree/non-degree courses with the grades computed in the basis of the number of units for each course will be granted with honors.

2.5.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_474
SECTION: Chapter 4 | Article 9. Residence Requirements and Time Limit. For most degrees and other qualifications, the University requires the students to spend a set amount of time receiving tuition or carrying out research.
Article 9. Residence Requirements and Time Limit. For most degrees and other qualifications, the University requires the students to spend a set amount of time receiving tuition or carrying out research.

Sec. 1. A master's degree student shall earn a minimum of 18 units within two

(2) semesters, whereas a doctorate aspirant shall complete a minimum of 27 units equivalent to three (3) semesters.

Sec. 2. All curricular requirements for a master's degree shall be completed within five (5) years after the student’s first enrolment in the master's program; those for doctorate shall be completed within seven (7) years after the student’s first enrolment in the doctorate program.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_407
SECTION: Chapter 3 | Article 2. Admission Requirements
Article 2. Admission Requirements

Sec. 1. LSPU Entrance Examination Instrument, Policies and Guidelines for Admission, and Retention (CMO 105, s. 2015)

1.1. Accommodation Capacity. Admission to this University shall be limited to the number of students for whom adequate facilities and competent faculty members are available to provide better instruction.

1.2. Free Higher Education. All students who are either currently enrolled at the time of the affectivity of the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act of 2017 or Unified Financial Assistance System for Tertiary Education Act, or UniFAST (Republic Act No.

10687) shall enroll at any time after that in a course leading to a bachelor’s degree in the University shall be exempt from paying tuition and other school fees for units enrolled in.

1.3. Institutional Qualifications. Students are eligible to receive the benefits stipulated in 1.2. provided that they qualify the admission and retention policies of the University.

Sec. 2. Admission and Testing

2.1. Non-discriminatory Admission. No student shall be denied admission to the University by reason of age, sex, gender, nationality, belief, or political affiliation.
